purpose: Secondary public WebSocket sensors for quote-shadow, dependency-break and propagation research. Research/paper only.

sensors.notes: Official docs expose aggregate trades, real-time bookTicker, and partial/diff depth. Keep disabled until smoke-tested from the target runner.
Official docs recommend public WebSocket for market data and order-book depth. Exact subscription payload should be verified in an isolated smoke adapter before enabling collection.

research_rules: Do not infer manipulation or actor identity from public market data.
A secondary sensor is promoted only after timestamp, book-state and health validation.
Compare quote changes and returns, not raw KRW-vs-USDT price levels.
All alpha evaluation remains paper-only until net executable alpha is validated out of sample.
